title: Villa Del Sol
meta_description: Find the perfect Destin, FL vacation rental at ‘Villa Del Sol’ a Luxury 9 Bedroom & 9 Bathroom vacation rental. Ideal for 33 guests, this home offers a Private Pool & Spa, Game Room, Elevator & Golf Cart for your enjoyment.
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: • 8 Bedrooms & 9 Full Baths • Sleeps 33 • SQFT: 4857 • Deeded Beach Access • 6 Seater Golf Cart & 6 Adult Bikes Included • Three Stories + Rooftop Terrace • Elevator • Gulf Views & Easy Beach Access • Heated Private Pool & Spa (Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $60 per day) • Summer Kitchen/Grill & Outdoor Dining • Game Room with Foosball, arcade & Shuffle • Parking for 6 Cars SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 33) FIRST FLOOR: (Sleeps 9) • Guest Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) with triple twin bunks (sleeps 3) & ensuite Bathroom – Single Vanity with Glass/Tile Shower • Bunk Area - Full over Full Bunks & Shared Bathroom with Single Vanity & Glass/Tile Shower SECOND FLOOR: (Sleeps 8) • Triple Queen Bunks (Sleeps 6) & Shared Bathroom with Single Vanity & Glass/Tile Shower • Guest Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) & ensuite Bathroom – Double Vanities with Glass/Tile Shower + Private Balcony THIRD FLOOR: (Sleeps 16) • Primary Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) & ensuite Bathroom – Double Vanities with Soaking Tub & Shower – Private Balcony • Guest Bedroom with Two Queen over Queen Bunks (sleeps 8) & ensuite Bathroom – Double Vanities with Shower/Tub Combo • Guest Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) & ensuite Bathroom – Double Vanities with Glass/Tile Shower • Guest Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) & ensuite Bathroom – Single Vanity with Glass/Tile Shower • Guest Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) & ensuite Bathroom – Single Vanity with Glass/Tile Shower + Private Balcony Escape to ‘Villa Del Sol’, your private oasis on the breathtaking Emerald Coast. With 8 luxurious bedrooms, a rooftop deck, pool, spa, and game room, this magnificent retreat is crafted for unforgettable gatherings. Just steps from crystal-clear waters and pristine white sands, Villa Del Sol promises an idyllic beachside escape. Inside, discover the seamless fusion of relaxed beach vibes and elegant style. An open-concept living area with ample seating invites everyone to unwind together, while the gourmet chef’s kitchen, complete with a Wolf gas range, three ovens, and a spacious island with barstool seating, makes dining a delight. For seamless entertaining, enjoy two ice makers, three dishwashers, and three full-sized fridge/freezer combinations, all complemented by a dining table that comfortably seats 16, with additional chairs for larger gatherings. The game room on the lower level offers a lively escape, equipped with arcade games, foosball, shuffleboard, two TVs, and a kitchenette. Step outside to a backyard oasis where a covered poolside patio with lounge seating and an outdoor kitchen await. Enjoy the warm Florida sunshine, take a refreshing dip in the pool, or stroll a few minutes to the exclusive beach—reserved for residents and guests—offering a private and serene experience. Multiple balconies and a stunning rooftop deck provide perfect spots to savor sunset views over the coastline. Imagine unwinding here with a cocktail, the sea breeze in your hair, and the golden hues of the sunset painting the sky. This is where vacation dreams come true. Nine well-appointed bedrooms are designed to accommodate up to 33 guests, featuring a variety of king, queen, and bunk beds to suit any group, with each bedroom having an ensuite or adjacent bath for added comfort and privacy. Located in vibrant Destin, Villa Del Sol combines a prime location with luxurious amenities, including ample parking and dual laundry facilities with two sets of washers and dryers for convenience. Every detail has been carefully considered to elevate your stay.
